name: capture.save
description: Gives a capture its brand (its own sender's tap: another sender's changes nothing) or its stored copy (src, its kind, who added it and the post's address on Instagram, when found), in either order. Once it has both, it becomes a pasted link of that brand with the capture's id: a reel for a video, a carousel for a photo, shown under Shared as added by the sender; it opens the post on Instagram, or our copy. saved says whether this call made it; the brand becomes the sender's last. Internal: packages/connect, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with c as (update brandbase.captures x set brand_id = coalesce(:brand, x.brand_id), src = coalesce(:src, x.src), kind = coalesce(:kind, x.kind), sender_name = coalesce(:name, x.sender_name), sender_handle = coalesce(:handle, x.sender_handle), permalink = coalesce(:link, x.permalink) where x.id = :id and x.sender = :sender returning x.*), p as (insert into brandbase.pasted_links (id, brand_id, created_at, reference) select c.id, c.brand_id, :now::timestamptz, jsonb_build_object('platform', 'ig', 'account', case when c.sender_handle <> '' then '@' || c.sender_handle when c.sender_name <> '' then c.sender_name else 'Instagram' end, 'addedBy', case when c.sender_handle <> '' then '@' || c.sender_handle when c.sender_name <> '' then c.sender_name end, 'link', coalesce(c.permalink, c.src), 'image', case when c.kind = 'image' then c.src else '' end, 'video', case when c.kind = 'video' then c.src end, 'ratio', case when c.kind = 'video' then 1.6 end, 'borrow', case when c.kind = 'video' then 'Shared reel' else 'Shared post' end, 'seed', jsonb_build_object('format', case when c.kind = 'video' then 'reel' else 'carousel' end, 'pillar', 'Craft', 'hook', 'New idea from a reference.', 'angle', 'What to borrow, in your words.', 'feature', '', 'shots', '[]'::jsonb, 'sharper', '[]'::jsonb)) from c where c.brand_id is not null and c.src is not null and c.kind is not null on conflict (id) do nothing returning brand_id), s as (insert into brandbase.capture_senders as y (account, sender, last_brand) select c.account, c.sender, c.brand_id from c where :brand::text is not null on conflict (account, sender) do update set last_brand = excluded.last_brand) select jsonb_build_object('saved', exists (select 1 from p), 'brand', c.brand_id, 'brandName', (select b.name from brandbase.brands b where b.id = c.brand_id), 'stored', c.src is not null) as result from c
